Class PatternMatchUtils

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.util.PatternMatchUtils
public abstract class PatternMatchUtils extends Object
用于简单模式匹配的实用方法，特别是针对 Spring 的典型 `xxx*`、`*xxx`、`*xxx*` 和 `xxx*yyy` 模式样式。
Since:
2.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

  • Method Details

    • simpleMatch

      @Contract("null, _ -> false; _, null -> false") public static boolean simpleMatch(@Nullable String pattern, @Nullable String str)
      Match a String against the given pattern, supporting direct equality as well as the following simple pattern styles: xxx*, *xxx, *xxx*, and xxx*yyy (with an arbitrary number of pattern parts).

      如果提供的 String 或模式为null，则返回false。

      Parameters:
      pattern - 要匹配的模式
      str - 要匹配的字符串
      Returns:
      String 是否匹配给定模式

    • simpleMatch

      @Contract("null, _ -> false; _, null -> false") public static boolean simpleMatch(String @Nullable [] patterns, @Nullable String str)
      Match a String against the given patterns, supporting direct equality as well as the following simple pattern styles: xxx*, *xxx, *xxx*, and xxx*yyy (with an arbitrary number of pattern parts).

      如果提供的 String 为null，或者提供的模式数组为null或为空，则返回false。

      Parameters:
      patterns - 要匹配的模式
      str - 要匹配的字符串
      Returns:
      该 String 是否匹配任何给定的模式
